name: Jujutsu: Shibuya Incident
summary:
In a modern world where unseen threats lurk beneath the surface, you are a newly awakened talent. Recruited into a secret academy, you must band together with allies to combat terrifying entities that seek to erode reality.
Master your unique “Contract,” command a team of powerful allies with distinct personalities, and survive in tactical, action-packed battles to uncover the truth behind the world’s distortion.
